children: Calgary, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - September 22, 2026) - Builders Capital Mortgage Corp.

") announced today that its board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.20 per Class A Non-Voting share of the Company. The distribution will be paid on October 30, 2026 to holders of Class A Non-voting shares of record on September 30, 2026.
The amount of the distribution is equivalent to $0.80 per Class A Non-Voting share per annum and is consistent with our target, and with our uninterrupted history of paying such distributions.
